props.label: About Us
props.heading: Your neighbourhood jeweller in Dhighori
props.body:
Dhanlaxmi Jewellers is a family jewellery shop at Teliphone Nagar Chowk on Narsala Road, Dhighori, Nagpur.

We keep gold and silver jewellery for everyday wear and for occasions — chains, rings, earrings, bangles and kada, mangalsutra, necklace sets, and silver articles for pooja and for gifting. If something is not on the counter, it can usually be ordered or made.

Buying jewellery should not feel complicated. The gold rate is public and changes daily, so we quote against the rate on the day you buy, show the weight on the scale in front of you, and explain making charges before you commit rather than after. Every purchase comes with a proper bill.

Gold jewellery sold in Nagpur must carry a BIS hallmark with its HUID by law, and ours does. Ask to see the hallmark on any piece and we will show you where it is stamped.

props.termsBody:
Gold and silver jewellery is priced against the prevailing metal rate on the day of purchase, plus making charges and applicable GST. Rates change daily and any figure quoted earlier is indicative only until billed.

Gold jewellery is sold with the BIS hallmark and HUID as required. Purity, gross weight and net weight are stated on the bill.

Exchange, buy-back and return terms are explained at the counter before purchase and are shown on your bill. Please retain the original bill and hallmark certificate — these are required for any exchange or buy-back.

Making charges and wastage are quoted per item before purchase and are not refundable on exchange.

Custom and order-made pieces may require an advance. Timelines are indicative and depend on the design and on karigar availability.

items.q: Why are prices not shown on the website?
items.a: Because gold and silver prices change every day. A gold piece is priced on its weight and purity at that day's metal rate, plus making charges and GST — so any figure printed here would be wrong within a day. Call or WhatsApp 97634 11624 and we will quote you the current price for what you have in mind.

Yes. Gold jewellery sold in Nagpur must carry the BIS hallmark along with a six-digit HUID, and ours does. Ask us on any piece and we will show you where it is stamped. Your bill states the purity, and the gross and net weight.

items.q: What is included in the price?
items.a: The metal value (weight multiplied by the day's rate for that purity), the making charges for that particular piece, and GST. We write these out as separate lines on the bill rather than giving you one combined figure, so you can see exactly what you are paying for.

items.q: Do you take old gold in exchange?
items.a: Yes. Bring the piece in — it is weighed and its purity tested in front of you, and we explain the terms before you agree to anything. Bring the original bill if you still have it. Making charges and wastage on the old piece are not refundable.

items.q: Can you make a design I have seen somewhere else?
items.a: Usually, yes. Bring a photograph or send it on WhatsApp and we will tell you whether it can be made, roughly what it will weigh and what it will cost. An advance is taken and the timeline depends on the design and on karigar availability.

items.q: Where exactly are you, and when are you open?
items.a: Teliphone Nagar Chowk, Narsala Road, Dhighori, Nagpur 440024. Please call 97634 11624 before travelling — it is worth confirming timings and that the piece you want is in stock before you make the trip.
